instruction: Use the Extensions view in VS Code to install the extension from the local file '/home/user/test.vsix'.

metadata.explanation: Specifying 'use the Extensions view' suggests GUI method instead of CLI. Same evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical runtime issue: Command uses pipe (|) but evaluator.result config does not specify 'shell': true parameter
The command is passed as a list ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'undefined_publisher.test'] which will fail without shell mode
get_vm_command_line has default shell=False (general.py:12), so pipe operations will not work - '|' and 'grep' will be passed as literal arguments to 'code' command
The overall verification approach is correct (checking installed extensions via code --list-extensions)
The expected value 'undefined_publisher.test' is correct and matches the extension identifier format
The is_extension_installed metric logic is correct for contain/not_contain checking
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Add 'shell': true to evaluator.result config, e.g., {'type': 'vm_command_line', 'command': ['code', '--list-extensions', '|', 'grep', 'undefined_publisher.test'], 'shell': true}

Option 2 (preferred): Remove pipe and use simple command without grep - just run 'code --list-extensions' and let the is_extension_installed metric do the string matching, e.g., {'type': 'vm_command_line', 'command': ['code', '--list-extensions']}
Option 3: If using shell mode, convert command from list to single string: 'code --list-extensions | grep undefined_publisher.test'
